name: Spiral Weapon Wheel
author: Henning Berge
description: A weapon wheel in the style of Prey (2017)'s favourites wheel: hold Triangle and the game slows down for a moment, then holds (Going Commando's own pause, run from its copied code), while everything you can put on the quick select (the Quick Select page's weapons and gadgets) lies on a spiral that the stick turns through, loop after loop, twelve to a loop. Each slot is a Ratchet & Clank menu panel bent into a sector: scanlines, a khaki frame, washed in its item's category colour as the game colours its icons (blue weapons, orange-tan gold weapons, green gadgets); the pointed-at one has the yellow Load Game frame and is pushed out. The glyphs are original drawings, in an icon pack other mods can add to or replace (an equipment mod's new weapon included); an item without one gets a glyph made from your own disc data; the quick select's items carry their number on a grey badge; the name and ammo show in the round middle panel; the health meter hides while it is open; let go of Triangle to equip. A double tap is the quick swap. No game-derived art is shipped: the panels are drawn as the mod loads. Settings: size, start angle, direction, the spiral's depth, hold or toggle, the hold before the pause, the slow-down and the ease back. Needs OpenRAC with mod interface 1.40 (pictures in a mod's overlay) and the hook points rac1.level.update_play, rac1.freeze.update and rac1.freeze.draw (not in a release yet). Spiral design from Prey Menu by KerosenileArsonist.

settings.name: Pause while open
settings.description: On: the world holds while the wheel is open (Going Commando's pause, after the slow-down). Off: the wheel opens over the running game, from Ratchet & Clank's own Triangle.

settings.name: Slow-down before pausing
settings.description: As the wheel opens the game's time eases down to an eighth of its speed, then the pause holds it, as Prey's wheel does. Short: about 0.15 s of game time; Prey-like: about 0.3 s; Off: the pause at once.

settings.name: Ease back on close
settings.description: On: as the wheel closes, the game's time eases back up the way it slowed down (an eighth of its speed to full). Off: it goes on at full speed at once.

settings.name: Open and close
settings.description: Hold: let go of Triangle to equip. Toggle: the wheel stays up when Triangle is let go; press Triangle again to equip. Circle closes it with nothing picked, either way.

settings.name: Hold before pausing
settings.description: How long Triangle is held before the wheel opens. Going Commando: its own 4 frames; a natural tap is often that long. A little longer (the default): 8 frames, so taps and double taps usually do not open it. Longer: 12 frames. On PAL each is scaled to its 50 ticks a second (3, 7, 10).

settings.name: Size
settings.description: The wheel's size: 1, the largest, is the design's as it fits a screen of any shape with a margin (its outermost slot and badge 3 % of the screen's height inside the edge); smaller values shrink it.

settings.name: Start angle
settings.description: Where the spiral starts, in degrees counter-clockwise from 3 o'clock: 90 is 12 o'clock, 0 is 3 o'clock, -90 is 6 o'clock. The first loop's first slot is there; your quick select's items sit at their own directions on that loop.

settings.name: Clockwise
settings.description: On (the design's): the spiral turns clockwise, each slot after the loop's first a little further in. Off: counter-clockwise (Prey Menu's default).

settings.name: Spiral motion
settings.description: Continuous: the spiral follows the pointer at all times, as Prey Menu's does; the pointed-at slot sits in the middle of the twelve shown whole, the ones further away fading out either side. Loop steps: the pointer's whole loop is shown, and the spiral turns to the next loop as the pointer crosses into it.

settings.name: Spiral depth
settings.description: How far in each slot is from the one before it: 11 pixels of a 720 pixel tall screen at the default 0.75 and below (the loops fill the screen), less above it (Prey Menu's fDepth, as its per-slot shrink), down to 5 at 1.

settings.name: Debug: preview gold (temporary)
settings.description: TEMPORARY, for testing the look: the wheel draws these weapons as gold ones (their colours, the Gold label), as if you owned their gold versions. The wheel only: nothing in the game changes, nothing is given. Removed before a release.

settings.name: Click sound
settings.description: A sound as the pointer moves to another item. Ratchet & Clank's quick select is silent and has no UI click: on, it plays a stand-in (the sound a help message opens with).
